questions.q: Core: f(x) = 3x + 2, g(x) = x² − 1. Find (a) f(−4) (b) gf(1) (c) f⁻¹(x) (d) solve f(x) = g(x), to 2 d.p.
Extend : f(x) = 2x − 5 and g(x) = (x + 1)/2. Show that gf(x) = x − 2 and explain why fg(x) = gf(x) has no solution.
questions.a: gf(x) = (2x − 5 + 1)/2 = x − 2; fg(x) = x + 1 − 5 = x − 4. x − 4 = x − 2 is never true

questions.q: Stretch : f(x) = (x + 3)/(x − 1), x ≠ 1. Show that ff(x) = x. What does this tell you about f⁻¹?
questions.a: ff(x) = 4x/4 = x, so f is its own inverse: f⁻¹ = f
